items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Bob Crossby came to me and asked me what I care to sit in, and at that time they called it Jam with the Boys, since we were from New Orleans.

ctx.x: Herb, were you ever present at any of those famous Chicago recording sessions like the Hot Fives or any of the Oliver sessions? No.

The only one I was present at was Bob Crossby. They had a recording session before us. We came on after them, and them fellas was really small guys. They had a case of scotch and soda, and they had heard a whole lot of talk of the Harlem Ham Fats, so they invited us in the studio, and we drank, listened at them recording. And after they finished, we started recording, and they stood a while and heard us a while. Now, getting back to the Navy Pinnah, Bob Crossby and his full crew chartered the boat that I used to…
Well, tell me, did you play with Crossby at any other time, any later date? No, no.
